notes: Test-only change (internal/app/integration_test.go, internal/app/lists_test.go); no production code touched.

Verified empirically against a throwaway postgres:16 container: main's TestSmallEndpointsRespond hits `panic: test timed out after 20s`; HEAD's version passes in 2.85s (the 2s deadline on the /lobby/stream probe accounts for most of it). The fix genuinely addresses the hang.

internal/app/events.go:46 — lobbyStream selects on r.Context().Done(), so the request-context deadline is the correct cancellation path; the same pattern is already used by TestLobbyStreamFlushesEvents (integration_test.go:1496).

internal/app/lists_test.go:112 — the 2s deadline applies to every probe, not just the SSE path. Under a heavily loaded CI runner a slow normal endpoint could hit the deadline and appear as a non-404 response; because the check only looks for endpoint_not_found, a timed-out probe would still be treated as 'routed', so this cannot cause a false failure, only a false pass on a genuinely unrouted path (unlikely: the 404 is produced by the router before any DB work).
Removing the dead `routed := ...; _ = routed` is a trivial cleanup inside the same test; not a scope concern.
Commit message claim about sites_code_key / users_username_key being deliberate 409 tests is consistent with integration_test.go:662 and similar StatusConflict assertions.
Fully revertible; no migrations, workflow, auth, or secret handling changes.
